_note: Hand-added directory listings for businesses that are not Chamber members (or to override a Chamber listing with the same name). Facts only, as the business publishes them; no private individuals' names. Fields: name (required), sections (array of section ids from directory.json, e.g. ["home"]), kinds (e.g. ["Plumbing"]), location, phone, website, email, social (facebook, instagram, tiktok, airbnb), about, source (where you verified it). After editing, run `npm run refresh:directory -- --manual-only`. To remove a listing for good (closed, moved, or asked to be removed), add it to "exclude" as {"name": "...", "reason": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}; this also blocks it from the Chamber data.

items.name: Cassidy Travel
items.about: Plans cruises, theme park vacations, all-inclusive resorts and group trips from Waynesville. Patrick Cassidy, an independent travel advisor with Fora Travel, specializes in multi-generational trips and travel for people with disabilities, autism and sensory needs. A power wheelchair user, Patrick checks accessible rooms, ride access, parking and quiet spaces before clients book. Credentials include Certified Autism Travel Professional, Certified Accessible Travel Advocate, College of Disney Knowledge graduate, and top-tier certification with Holland America, Princess, Norwegian and Virgin Voyages. No planning fee for vacations.
items.source: Description supplied by the business, 2026-10-31; https://cassidytravel.org/
